name: task-workflow
title_zh: 一份任务简报管到底的施工队长，拆解、执行、复查
tagline_zh: 目标拆成任务后，不用反复交代进度。它自己记简报、分派执行、收拢复查，连要不要提交都等你点头。
tagline_en: Break goals into tasks, then let one brief carry you through execution, continuation, and review. No.
desc_en: Lead repository work through a persistent task brief with separate planning, execution, continuation, review, and optional commit phases. Use when the user asks to plan or split a goal into tasks, create or update a task brief, act as lead agent, execute or continue a planned goal, coordinate builders and reviewers, close review findings, or execute and commit. Trigger phrases include 规划这个目标, 执行这个
why_zh: 把计划、执行、续做、复查拆成独立阶段，靠持久简报衔接，不会一换话题就丢上下文。队长型协调，不越权提交。
why_en: Separates planning, doing, continuing, and reviewing via a living brief—so context survives interruptions. Acts as lead agent.
limit_zh: 只认文本任务简报，不接图片/语音输入；提交阶段需你明确指示才执行 git commit；不自动处理外部依赖或环境错误。
limit_en: Text-only task briefs; no image/voice input. Commit only on explicit instruction. Stops and asks when hitting external dependency or environment.
title_en: A persistent task brief that leads planning, execution.
